# Receipt Cycle

> Receipt Cycle is a web and Android app for freelancers, independent professionals, and small businesses. It captures receipts with AI extraction and keeps expenses, customers, estimates, invoices, payment records, budgets, and reports connected in one workspace.

Last updated: 2026-10-29

## Facts

- Website: https://receiptcycle.com/
- Platforms: web app (any current browser) and Android app. [Get Receipt Cycle on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.receiptcycle.mobile&udm=14).
- Operator: Receipt Cycle is the trade name of TempEmailGen.
- Support: support@receiptcycle.com (replies within one business day)
- Audience: freelancers, independent professionals, contractors, and small businesses.
- Language: English (US).

## What it does

- Receipt capture with AI extraction of merchant, date, total, tax, and line items
- Expense and income records with categories, accounts, and notes
- Customer records and a reusable products and services catalog
- Estimates and invoices with tax, discounts, and payment terms
- Payment records, balances, and payment receipts
- Monthly category budgets compared with recorded spending
- Income, expense, cash flow, and overdue invoice reports
- Ask AI questions about saved records
- CSV transaction export on paid plans

## Pricing

- Free: $0. 7-day trial with Pro-style features; up to 25 transactions during trial (all entry types). No CSV export on Free.
- Pro Monthly: $3.50 per month with a 7-day free trial. Unlimited transactions, receipt scan, upload and manual entry, budgets, full edit access, CSV export.
- Pro Yearly: $35 per year with a 7-day free trial. Everything in Pro Monthly.
- Pro Lifetime: $60 one time, launch offer. Everything in Pro Monthly with no monthly charges.
- Prices are in USD. Payments are processed by Polar, which acts as merchant of record. Monthly and yearly plans can be cancelled from the account.

## Limits

- Receipt Cycle is not a full accounting system: no general ledger, payroll, inventory, or tax filing.
- It records payments received through other methods. It is not a payment gateway and does not collect customer funds.
- It does not give accounting, tax, legal, or investment advice. AI output must be checked against the saved records.
- No iOS app is published.

## Product and feature pages

- [Invoice Software for Small Businesses](https://receiptcycle.com/invoice-software): Create polished invoices, send them to customers, and track what is paid or outstanding from one straightforward workspace.
- [Estimate and Quotation Software](https://receiptcycle.com/estimate-quotation-software): Create a detailed estimate, send it for review, and turn accepted work into an editable invoice without entering the job twice.
- [Payment Tracking and Receipt Management Software](https://receiptcycle.com/payment-tracking-software): Record full or partial invoice payments, update the balance, and create a receipt without rebuilding the transaction in another file.
- [AI Receipt Scanner](https://receiptcycle.com/ai-receipt-scanner): Photograph or upload a receipt, extract the visible purchase details, and review the expense before it joins your records.
- [Business Travel Expense Tracker](https://receiptcycle.com/business-travel-expense-tracker): Capture travel receipts, review every purchase, and return to an organized record of airfare, lodging, meals, and transportation.
- [Freelancer Tax & Receipt Tracker](https://receiptcycle.com/freelancer-tax-receipt-tracker): Capture business purchases as they happen, preserve the supporting receipt, and prepare an organized record for tax-time review.
- [Business Budgeting & Expense Planning](https://receiptcycle.com/business-budgeting-software): Set monthly category limits, compare them with recorded expenses, and open the purchases behind every total.
- [Client & Customer Management for Invoicing](https://receiptcycle.com/client-management-software): Keep customer details, document history, outstanding balances, and reusable services ready for the next estimate or invoice.
- [Expense Reports & Financial Reporting](https://receiptcycle.com/expense-reporting-software): Review income, expenses, category spending, cash movement, payments, and overdue invoices without rebuilding the month by hand.
- [AI Financial Assistant and AI Expense Analysis](https://receiptcycle.com/ai-financial-assistant): Ask about spending, categories, merchants, income, expenses, and recent activity using the records already saved in Receipt Cycle.

## How to cite

Public pages may be crawled, quoted, and cited by search engines and AI assistants.
Cite the canonical page URL (for example https://receiptcycle.com/pricing) and name the source as "Receipt Cycle". For prices and plan details, prefer the pricing page, which is the source of truth. The signed-in app (dashboard, invoices, reports, settings) is private and not for crawling.
